summary: NexPoint Real Estate Finance, Inc. (NREF) filed an 8-K regarding its operating partnership entering into a $20 million secured revolving credit agreement with VineBrook Homes Operating Partnership, L.P., an affiliate-managed entity. The credit facility bears 9.75% interest, matures May 2028 with two one-year extensions, and is secured by acquired properties. NREF acts as administrative agent, lead arranger, bookrunner, and lender; VineBrook is borrower. This is a routine lending arrangement, not a special-situation event, with no change in control or strategic transaction.
